messages:
June Park: Quick review: updated compare table mock that highlights performance badges and makes pin wording explicit. need a11y + copy sanity check.
Leo Anders: Cool. can you summarize key changes?
June Park: 1) Badges now include metric name and tier: e.g. 'Latency (median): Low'. 2) 'Pin model version' replaces 'Pin version'. 3) Compact legend collapsed on mobile with '?' icon. 4) Badge opens a small popover; row opens detail drawer.
Rina Sato: Accessibility notes: add visually-hidden text for badges: 'Latency tier: Low. median 42ms.' Use aria-live for pin/unpin updates.
Devon Cruz: Backend: we'll return pinned_strategy: static|follow_patch and metric_mode: median|p95. UI should display strategy in the row subtitle.
Leo Anders: Copy tweak: badge labels should avoid 'Low' alone; use full phrase 'Latency: Low (<50ms)'. Also add tooltip copy: 'Median latency across serving region.'
Rina Sato: Contrast scan: badge text on colored backgrounds fails for small text. propose white bold text and increase badge padding to allow larger font size.
June Park: Mobile: ensure badge has 44px tap target; extend hit area even if visual is small. Legend modal for mobile should be reachable from header '?' icon.
Devon Cruz: Sorting: optional toggle 'Pinned first' in toolbar. if enabled, pinned rows float to top with a 'Pinned' group label. API will include a pinned boolean to support it.
accessibility-bot: Automated checks: 2 failures: badge contrast, modal close icon size.
Rina Sato: I'll fix contrast and bump icon to recommended touch size. Also add keyboard shortcut: Enter to open focused row, Space to toggle pin.
June Park: Great. Next steps: Rina to update Figma and annotations, Devon to add API fields and tickets, Leo to finalize microcopy. Reconvene Thursday 9am PT.
